permissionRationale._comment: Minimal set. CAMERA/RECORD_AUDIO/POST_NOTIFICATIONS/READ_MEDIA_IMAGES are just-in-time (requested via src/utils/permissions.ts only when the feature is used). SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW is NOT declared: chat-head overlay is requested at runtime via chatHeadNative.requestOverlayPermission only after explicit user consent in Settings. READ_PHONE_STATE removed (not essential; CallKeep uses MANAGE_OWN_CALLS). Legacy READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE removed; scoped READ_MEDIA_IMAGES only (API 33+).
permissionRationale.overlay: SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW intentionally omitted — runtime-only with explicit consent.

plugins.faceIDPermission: JABY uses Face ID to unlock your encrypted enclave.

plugins.cameraPermission: JABY needs camera access for video calls.
plugins.microphonePermission: JABY needs microphone access for voice calls.

updates._comment: OTA channel is per build profile (see eas.json channels): production=production, preview=preview, development=development. This requestHeaders value is the production default baked at build time; preview/dev builds override via their eas.json channel (EAS injects the channel at build). Do NOT hardcode preview/dev here — one app.json serves all profiles.
